persona: Plain-spoken and patient. Has one photo and the builder quote PDF, which turns out to be damaged.
initial_message: Hello, strong wind on Tuesday 22 September tore three of the clear roof sheets off the pergola at the back of our house and cracked two more. One of the aluminium purlins is bent too. Nobody was hurt. I'd like to make a claim.

facts.policyholder.name: Mateo Wakathorne
facts.incident.description: Strong wind on Tuesday afternoon tore three clear polycarbonate roof sheets off the pergola at the back of the house and cracked two more. One of the aluminium purlins bent.
facts.loss.description: Three pergola roof sheets torn off, two cracked; one aluminium purlin bent
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Picked up the loose sheets from the lawn and stacked them in the garage
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the pergola roof. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Elm Garth Renovations as a PDF, dated 25 September 2026. The builder told me the total is $2,426.50 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_the_quote_file: It opened on my phone when they emailed it. I do not know why it will not open for you. I can ask them to send it again.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo taken from a timber deck looking up at the roof of a pergola attached to the back of a house after a storm. Three clear corrugated polycarbonate roof sheets are missing, leaving open gaps in the aluminium frame, two remaining sheets are cracked across, and one aluminium purlin sags downward, bent. Grey sky through the gaps and a torn sheet lying on the deck boards. The frame shows only the pergola roof and the deck.
materials.purpose: Shows the wind damage to the pergola roof

materials.purpose: The repair quote, truncated so that it cannot be opened
Policy schedule that matches the home wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: Boundary: the repair quote PDF is truncated to 40 % of its bytes and cannot be opened; the photo is fine.

triage.rationale: The repair quote cannot be opened, so a readable copy is still needed. Nobody was hurt, the house is not affected inside and nothing is still happening. The claimant can state the total (NZD 2,426.50) if asked, but the document itself shows nothing, so whether the amount counts as known is left open. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: The only quote is a corrupt file, so its date cannot be read

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2023-06-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.note: Matched by file name: until the chat upload lets the claimant pick the material, the runner must not set evidence_kind through the API (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent tells the claimant that the quote file cannot be opened and asks for it to be sent again.
assertions.note: Needs PDF reading or a file check on the dev stack (#1129); until then the Agent cannot tell that the file is broken.

assertions.rubric: The Agent describes the contents or the total of the quote document as if it had read it. Repeating a total or a date the claimant states is fine.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks the claimant for the quote total
